name: TheVault
summary: Network where magicians share short effect videos, tag the technique and get signed peer critique.
description: A video network for magicians. Members record or upload 5-60 second clips of effects, tag the technique and receive named peer ratings on three separate axes - originality, execution and teaching quality - instead of anonymous stars. The wall is kept as a dated archive of the craft rather than a chronological feed, and clips are served encrypted with leak monitoring. Accounts are free for now; a paid plan is announced but not priced.
contains: 5-60 second video clips of magic effects
signed peer voting on originality, execution and teaching quality
dated archive with tags, not a chronological feed
filterable catalog by sub-axis, minimum threshold and sort order
free accounts now; paid plan announced without a price
